title: In this town, the school bus never leaves until every kid is on

tts.note: free match for the channel voice (ElevenLabs Liam TX3LPaxmHKxFdv7VOQHJ)

lines.text: In this town, the school bus never leaves until *every* kid is on. *No* exceptions.
Even if it rains. Even if it makes the whole bus late.
And every morning, the kid it waits for, is *me*.
The whole bus calls me *Late* Leo.
Mister Earl, the driver, never says a word. He just nods, and closes the door.
He keeps a small *pink* lunchbox on his dashboard.
There's a warning letter on his seat. Late for his second job. *Again*.
And whenever I forget my little sister's lunch, it somehow shows up at her daycare anyway.
My mom works nights. So every morning, I wake up my sister, make her breakfast, and tie her shoes.
Then I walk her to daycare, and *run*.
One morning, I was so late, I knew the bus had to be *gone*.
But when I turned the corner, it was still *there*.
Mister Earl was standing outside, holding a pink lunchbox. My sister's.
He smiled and said, I know, kid. I've known all year.
And for the first time, nobody on that bus said a *word*.
In this town, the bus waits for every kid. *Especially* the ones nobody waits for at home.
